spans.s:
पंश् पंश् or पंस्, cl. 1. and 10. P.
पंशति, पंसति, पंशयति, पंसयति,
&c., to destroy.

पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen, gone down or down-
wards, sunk, descended; gone; (अस्), m. downward
motion, falling, descent, fall; creeping on the ground.
—पन्न-ग, अस्, m. ‘creeping along the ground,’
a snake, serpent, serpent-demon or Nāga; a species
of plant (= पद्म-काष्ठ); (आ), f. a female
serpent, a female serpent-demon; (ई), f. a species of
shrub (= सर्पिणी).
—पन्नग-केशर, अस्, m.
Mesua Roxburghii.
—पन्नग-नाशन, अस्, m.
‘serpent-destroyer,’ an epithet of Garuḍa, the bird
and vehicle of Viṣṇu.
—पन्नग-मय, अस्, ई,
अम्, formed or consisting of serpents.
—पन्नगारि
(˚ग-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of serpents,’ an epithet
of Garuḍa; N. of a teacher; (also read पन्न-
गानि.)
—पन्नगाशन (˚ग-अश्˚), अस्, m. ‘serpent-
devourer,’ an epithet of Garuḍa.
—पन्नागार (˚न-
अग्˚ or आग्˚), अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N.
of his descendants.
पन्न पन्न. See p. 531, col. 1.

1. पान, अम्, n. (for 2. see col. 2), drinking,
drinking spirituous liquors; enjoying; a drink,
beverage; a drinking-vessel, cup; a canal; (अस्),
m. a distiller, one who sells spirituous liquors,
a publican, inn-keeper; [cf. Lith. péna-s, ‘milk.’]
—पान-कुम्भ, अस्, m. a drinking-vessel.
—पान-
गोष्ठिका or पान-गोष्ठी, f. a drinking-party,
drinking-bout; a dram-shop, tavern, place where
people drink together.
—पान-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, caused
by drinking (as a disease).
—पान-दोष, अस्, m.
the vice of drinking, drunkenness.
—पान-प, अस्,
आ, अम्, a dram-drinker, drinker of spirituous liquors.
—पान-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, addicted to drinking.
—पान-पात्र, अम्, n. a drinking-vessel, glass, cup,
goblet.
—पान-बणिज्, क्, m. a vender of spirits, a
distiller.
—पान-भाजन, अम्, n. a drinking-vessel,
glass, goblet.
—पान-भाण्ड, अम्, n. a drinking-
vessel.
—पान-भू, ऊस्, or पान-भूमि, इस् or ई, f.
a drinking-place, drinking-room, refreshment-room.
—पान-मङ्गल, अम्, n. a drinking-party, drink-
ing-bout.
—पान-मद, अस्, m. intoxication.
—पा-
न-रत, अस्, आ, अम्, addicted to drink, drinking,
drunken, a toper.
—पान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. abound-
ing in drink, rich in beverages.
—पान-विभ्रम, अस्,
m. ‘drink-giddiness,’ intoxication.
—पान-शौण्ड,
अस्, आ, अम्, addicted to intoxication; (अस्), m. a hard
drinker.
—पानागार (˚न-अग्˚ or -आग्˚), अस्, m. a
drinking-house, tavern.
—पानात्यय (˚न-अत्˚), अस्,
m. hard drinking, drinking; morbid state after in-
toxication.

पान 1. पान, पानीय, पान्त. See p. 560,
cols. 1, 2.

पान 2. पान, अस्, m. = अपान, breath,
breathing out, expiration.

पन् पन्, cl. 1. P. A. पनायति, -ते, (Ved.
पनयति, -ते), पेने, पनिता or पना-
यिता, पनितुम् or पनायितुम् (mostly Ved.), to be
worthy of admiration; to admire; to regard with
surprise or wonder; to praise; to acknowledge,
recognise; (A.) to rejoice at, be glad of, con-
gratulate one's self upon (with gen.).

पनयाय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. worthy of admira-
tion, admirable; astonishing, surprising.

पनस्य, Nom. A. पनस्यते, &c., Ved. to
show one's self worthy of admiration, be admirable.

पनस्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. showing one's self
worthy of admiration, boasting; an epithet of the
Maruts, of Indra, &c.
पनायित, अस्, आ, अम्, praised.

पनाय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. worthy of admiration,
admirable, surprising.
पनित, अस्, आ, अम्, admired, praised.

पनितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, acknowledging with praise,
praising.

पनिप्नत्, अत्, अती, अत् (pres. part. of the Intens.),
Ved. showing one's self worthy of admiration or praise.
पनिष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. (perhaps) admiration, praise.

पनिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. very wonderful,
exceedingly glorious or praiseworthy.

पनीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, Ved. more wonderful or
praiseworthy, very wonderful.
पनु, उस्, or पनू, ऊस्, Ved. admiration, praise.
पन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. praiseworthy; astonishing.

पन्यस्, आन्, असी, अस्, Ved. = पनीयस्, more won-
derful, very wonderful.

पनस पनस, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
पन्), the bread-fruit or Jaka tree, Artocarpus Inte-
grifolia; a thorn; a species of serpent; N. of a
monkey; (आ or ई), f. a malady, pustular and phleg-
monoid inflammation of the skin or external organs;
a female monkey; a female demon; (अम्), n. the
bread-fruit, fruit of the Jaka tree.
—पनस-तालिका
or (according to some) पनस-नालिका, f. the bread-
fruit tree.

पनसिका, f. a kind of disease, pustules on the
ears and neck.

पनिष्पद पनिष्पद, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Intens.
of स्पन्द्), Ved. quivering, palpitating.

पन्थ् पन्थ्, cl. 1. and 10. P. पन्थति,
पन्थयति, &c., to go, move.

पन्थक पन्थक, अस्, आ, अम्, produced in
or on the way; (अस्), m., N. of a Brāhman.
पन्दर पन्दर, अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
पन्नद्धा पन्-नद्धा. See p. 529, col. 3.

पानक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a draught, drink, beverage,
potion.
पानिक, अस्, m. a vender of spirituous liquors.
पानिल, अम्, n. a drinking-vessel.

1. पानीय, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see col. 2), to
be drunk, drinkable; (अम्), n. a beverage, drink;
water.
—पानीय-काकिका, f. ‘sea-crow,’ the cormo-
rant.
—पानीय-नकुल, अस्, m. ‘water-ichneumon,’
an otter.
—पानीय-पृष्ठ-ज, अस्, m. ‘born on
the surface of the water,’ an aquatic plant, Pistia
Stratiotes.
—पानीय-फल, अम्, n. the seed of
Euryala Ferox.
—पानीय-मूलक, अम्, n. the plant
Vernonia Anthelminthica.
—पानीय-वर्णिका, f.
sand (= बालुका).
—पानीय-शाला or पानीय-शा-
लिका, f. a place where water is distributed, a shed on
the road-side for providing passengers with water.
—पानीय-शीत, अस्, आ, अम्, too cold to drink.
—पा-
नीयाध्यक्ष (˚य-अध्˚), अस्, m. a superintendent
of the water.
—पानीयामलक (˚य-आम्˚), अम्, n.
a kind of fruit, Flacourtia Cataphracta.
—पानीयार्-
थम् (˚य-अर्˚), ind. for the sake of water.
—पानी-
यालु (˚य-आलु), उस्, m. a species of tuberous plant
(= जलालु, क्षुपालु).
—पानीयाश्रा (˚य-अश्˚), f.
a species of grass (= वल्वजा, दृढ-क्षुरा).

2. पानीय, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 1. see col. 1), to be
cherished or protected, to be preserved.

पांशु पांशु, पांशन, &c., = पांसु, पां-
सन, &c. below.

पांसु पांसु, उस्, m. (in later writings mostly
spelt पांशु; probably fr. rt. पंस् or पंश्, to
destroy), crumbling soil, dust, sand; a particle of
dust, grain of sand; dung, manure; a species of
plant (= पर्पट); a kind of camphor; landed
property; [cf. Lat. pulvis for pulcvis; Cambro-
Brit. pain, ‘pollen, fine powder or dust.’]
—पांसु-
कासीस, अम्, n. sulphate of iron.
—पांसु-कुली, f.
‘multitude of dust,’ a high road, highway.
—पांसु-
कूल, अम्, n. a dust-heap, particularly a collection of
rubbish and rags out of which the Buddhist priests
make up their clothing; a legal document not made
out in any particular person's name.
—पांसुकूल-
सीवन, अम्, n. ‘the sewing together of rags from a
dust-heap,’ N. of the place where Śākya-muni assumed
his priestly dress.
—पांसुकूलिक, अस्, आ, अम्, one
who wears clothes made of rags from a dust-heap.
—पांसु-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with dust,
dusty.
—पांसु-क्षार = पांसु-ज, q. v.
—पांसु-
गुण्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with dust.
—पांसु-
चत्वर, अम्, n. hail.
—पांसु-चन्दन, अस्, m.
an epithet of Śiva.
—पांसु-चामर, अस्, m. a heap
of dust; a tent; a bank covered with Dūrvā grass;
praise; a small cucumber.
—पांसु-ज, अम्, n. ‘earth-
born,’ a kind of salt extracted from soil, rock or fossil
salt.
—पांसु-जालिक, अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
—पांसु-धूम्र, अस्, आ, अम्, dark-red or dark
with dust; [cf. धूलि-धूम्र.]
—पांसु-ध्वस्त-
शिरोरुह, अस्, आ, अम्, having the hair soiled with
dust.
—पांसु-निपात, अस्, m. a fall of dust.
—पां-
सु-पटल, अम्, n. a coating or mass of dust.
—पांसु-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a kind of vegetable, Che-
nopodium Album.
—पांसु-भव, अस् or अम्, m.
or n. (?) = पांसु-ज, q. v.
—पांसु-मर्दन, अस्,
m. ‘dust-destroying,’ an excavation for water round
the root of a tree.
—पांसु-रागिणी, f. a species of
plant (= महा-मदा).
—पांसु-राष्ट्र, अम्, n.,
N. of a country; (आस्), m. pl., N. of its inhabitants.
—पांसु-वर्ष, अस्, m. a shower of dust, falling
dust.
—पांसु-समूहन, अस्, ई, अम्, collecting or
raising dust (as the wind).
—पांसुत्कर (˚सु-उत्˚),
अस्, m., Ved. = पांसु-वर्ष.

पांसक, अस्, आ, अम्, vitiating, spoiling; con-
temptible, vile.

पांसन, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, (at the end of a comp.)
defiling, disgracing, dishonouring; vitiating, spoiling,
[]
destructive; contemptible, wicked, bad, infamous;
(अम्), n. contempt.

पान्सिन्, ई, इनी, इ, = पांसन (for which it is
probably only a wrong reading).

पांसुक, आस्, m. pl. dust; (आ), f. a menstruous
woman; a fragrant plant, Pandanus Odoratissimus.

पांसुर, अस्, आ, अम्, dusty (Ved.); a gad-fly; a
cripple carried or moving about in a chair.

पांसुल or पांशुल, अस्, आ, अम्, dusty, covered with
dust; sullied, defiled, disgraced; defiling, disgracing
(e. g. कुल-पांसुल, disgracing a family, a disgrace to
the family); (अस्), m. a wicked or profligate man, a
libertine, paramour, gallant; one of Śiva's weapons
(a sort of pole armed at the upper end with transverse
pieces representing the breast-bone and adjoining ribs
and surmounted by a skull); an epithet of Śiva; a
species of tree, Cæsalpinia Bonducella; (आ), f. a
menstruous woman; a licentious woman, (अ-पां-
शुला, a chaste woman); the earth; Pandanus Odo-
ratissimus.

पान्थ पान्थ, अस्, m. (fr. पथिन्), a wan-
derer, traveller; ‘the wanderer in the sky,’ the sun.

पान्नग पान्नग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पन्न-ग),
formed or consisting of snakes, having serpents, snaky.

पान्नेजन पान्नेजन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 3. पद् +
नेजन), Ved. used for washing the feet; (अम्), n.
a vessel in which the feet are washed, foot-bath.
